description: Generalize lugh's trainer by porting the valuable pieces of cuneiform's retired archive/apps/web/scripts/train.py (a generic config-driven harness) that lugh's task-specialized pipelines lack, reconciled with the existing kft.py/kft_run.py contract layer. Turns lugh from 'trains our tasks' into 'executes any KFT job'. See pinakes docs/LUGH-EXTRACTION-PLAN.md.

userStories.title: Generic multi-format dataset harness
userStories.description: Port dataset auto-detection + formatters for alpaca / sharegpt / chatml / completion / text, so the executor accepts any KFT job's dataset shape (not only the ChatML rule-SFT corpus).
acceptanceCriteria: A dataset layer detects and formats alpaca/sharegpt/chatml/completion/text inputs, unit-tested per format.
The KFT executor path (kft_run.py) uses it, so an admitted job with any supported dataset shape trains.
It reuses lugh's existing ChatML rendering where they overlap (no divergent second ChatML path).

userStories.title: Unsloth fast path + method:full
userStories.description: Add an optional unsloth-accelerated QLoRA/LoRA path (gated, undeclared dep like the rest of the heavy stack) and support method:full, alongside the existing trl/peft path.
acceptanceCriteria: When unsloth is installed, the LoRA/QLoRA path uses FastLanguageModel; otherwise it falls back to trl/peft (require-deps gate + actionable message).
method:full is supported; the method x modality matrix matches the KCB manifest from tasklist 30.
CPU/tiny-fixture tests exercise the path selection without needing a GPU.

userStories.title: KFT §6 streaming telemetry + graceful cancellation
userStories.description: Emit training telemetry as a stream shaped to KFT §6 (what cuneiform's Subprocess/Kcb runner reads), and handle SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful shutdown so a delegated job can be cancelled.
acceptanceCriteria: A training callback streams KFT §6-shaped telemetry (step/epoch/loss/eval/lr/progress) that cuneiform's runner can consume.
SIGTERM/SIGINT stops training gracefully and records a cancelled status.
Telemetry shape is asserted against the vendored koine KFT §6 contract; the stub/tiny-fixture path runs in CI.
